description: This phase explores adult experiences (ages 20-30) to understand career development, life purpose, and personal growth — connecting past patterns to present identity and future vision.

categories.name: Career Development & Professional Identity
categories.description: Understanding career motivation, professional growth, work values, and career decision-making
categories.source: Career Development and Counseling, Career Growth Systematic Review, Career Transitions Across the Lifespan

questions.direct_question: What inspired you to pursue your current career or profession?
questions.purpose: Understanding career motivation and initial career choice

questions.direct_question: How has your definition of career success changed since you first started working?
questions.purpose: Understanding career identity and evolving career goals

questions.direct_question: What motivates you to continue growing professionally?
Can you describe a skill you've intentionally developed to improve your career?
questions.purpose: Understanding lifelong learning and professional development

questions.direct_question: What aspects of your work give you the greatest sense of satisfaction?
How do you usually prepare yourself for future career opportunities?
Can you tell me about a career challenge that helped you grow professionally?
What role has continuous learning played in your career journey?
How do you decide which professional opportunities are worth pursuing?
Can you describe a time when you stepped outside your comfort zone to advance your career?
Who has influenced your professional development the most, and how?
What personal qualities have helped you succeed in your career?
How do you stay motivated when your career doesn't progress as quickly as you expected?
Can you tell me about a career decision that significantly changed your professional path?
What work values are most important to you when choosing or staying in a job?
How do you balance achieving professional goals with maintaining your personal well-being?
Can you share an experience where feedback helped improve your professional performance?
How has your career shaped the way you see yourself as a professional?
Looking ahead, what kind of professional impact would you like to make through your work?
questions.purpose: Understanding long-term career aspirations and purpose

questions.direct_question: Looking back on your career so far, what accomplishment makes you feel most proud, and why?
questions.purpose: Understanding achievement, fulfillment, and career meaning

questions.direct_question: Have you ever considered changing careers entirely? What would that look like?
questions.purpose: Understanding career exploration and openness to change
questions.scenario_hook: Imagine exploring a completely different path—what would it look like?

questions.direct_question: Do you feel your career aligns with your deeper purpose, or is it separate?

categories.name: Purpose & Meaning
categories.description: Understanding life purpose, meaning, values, and what drives the user's sense of fulfillment
categories.source: Meaning in Life Questionnaire (MLQ), Purpose in Life Theory, SAGE Purpose Study, Adult Development, Psychology of Purpose

questions.direct_question: What currently gives your life the greatest sense of purpose?
How has your understanding of your life's purpose changed over the years?
Can you describe an experience that helped you discover what truly matters to you?
What motivates you to keep moving forward during difficult periods in your life?
Which personal values guide most of your important life decisions?
How do your daily activities contribute to the kind of life you want to build?
questions.purpose: Understanding alignment between daily actions and long-term purpose

questions.direct_question: Can you share a goal that has remained meaningful to you for many years?
What kinds of experiences make your life feel meaningful?
How do you define a fulfilling life?
Can you describe a time when helping someone else gave your life greater meaning?
How have your relationships influenced your sense of purpose?
What role does personal growth play in living a meaningful life?
When you face uncertainty, what helps you stay focused on your long-term direction?
Can you describe a challenge that changed your outlook on life?
What achievements have brought you the greatest sense of personal fulfillment?
How do you know when your life is moving in the direction you want?
What legacy or positive impact would you like to leave through your life?
How do your career, relationships, and personal interests work together to create a meaningful life?
questions.purpose: Understanding integration of multiple life roles

questions.direct_question: What is one belief or principle that consistently shapes the choices you make?
Looking ahead, what kind of person do you hope to become, and why is that important to you?
questions.purpose: Understanding future identity and life purpose

questions.direct_question: Does your work contribute to your sense of purpose, or do you find purpose outside work?
Have you ever felt torn between different purposes or values?

categories.name: Growth & Vision
categories.description: Understanding personal growth, future vision, adaptability, and intentional life direction
categories.source: Growth Mindset Scale, Personal Growth Guide, Neuroplasticity Strategy, Future Orientation, Goal Setting Theory, Journal of Happiness Studies

questions.direct_question: How have you changed as a person over the past few years?
What experiences have contributed the most to your personal growth?
What new skills or abilities are you actively trying to develop?
How do you usually respond when faced with a challenge you've never encountered before?
Can you describe a setback that ultimately helped you grow?
What habits have played the biggest role in your personal development?
How do you challenge yourself to continue learning and improving?
How do you know that you are becoming a better version of yourself?
What personal quality are you currently working to improve?
How have your values influenced the person you are becoming?
questions.purpose: Understanding growth guided by personal values

questions.direct_question: What kind of future do you want to create for yourself?
Where do you see yourself five to ten years from now?
What motivates you to keep working toward your long-term goals?
How do you ensure your daily actions support the future you want?
questions.purpose: Understanding alignment between present behavior and future vision

questions.direct_question: Can you describe a goal that has remained important to you over time?
How do you adapt your plans when unexpected situations arise?
questions.purpose: Understanding flexibility in pursuing future goals

questions.direct_question: What opportunities do you hope to create for yourself in the future?
When you imagine your future, what excites you the most?
How do you balance personal growth with achieving your long-term goals?
questions.purpose: Understanding the relationship between growth and vision

questions.direct_question: Looking ahead, what kind of person do you hope to become, and what steps are you taking to get there?
questions.purpose: Understanding future identity and intentional growth

questions.direct_question: What obstacles have stood in the way of your personal growth, and how have you overcome them?
questions.purpose: Understanding barriers to growth and resilience

questions.direct_question: How have your relationships influenced your personal growth?

follow_up_strategies.if_emotional: That sounds really meaningful. What do you think that experience taught you about yourself?
follow_up_strategies.if_brief: I'm curious about that—what made that so significant to you?
follow_up_strategies.if_resistant: That's okay. We can come back to it later if you'd prefer. Let's try another question.
follow_up_strategies.if_reflective: That's a beautiful way to put it. What do you think that says about who you are today?
follow_up_strategies.if_general: That's interesting. Can you tell me more about that?
follow_up_strategies.if_hesitant: Take your time. Sometimes the best answers come when we let them find us.
follow_up_strategies.if_surprising: That's fascinating—I didn't expect that. What do you think made you feel that way?
